Windows installer fix.

- **Reinstalling no longer fails with "Access denied".** On Windows a running readscout (your coding agent's MCP server, the setup page) locks its own files. The installer now closes those processes first. Restart your coding agent afterwards.

Update: run the installer again, or `uv tool install --force https://github.com/Anarchiejs/readscout/releases/download/v0.1.4/readscout-0.1.4-py3-none-any.whl`.
Plugin users: `/plugin marketplace update readscout`, then restart Claude Code.
